However, , able explore prototype development API (https://api-dev.vegbank.org). Configure vegbankr use development API using following expression: many projects currently registered VegBank? Search “GAP” related projects, returning sorted descending order observation count. Get first 100 plot observations associated project pj.11044 (Pennsylvania HP Delaware Water Gap), sorted author_obs_code, check located. Grab single plot observation record based “ob” code. Get taxon (plant) observations associated plot observation, displaying order based plant code current taxon interpretation. Now search community concepts string "_sequoiadendron_". Determine concept plot observations, retrieve plot observations VegBank.
code: library(vegbankr)  # the package default URL is https://api.vegbank.org vb_set_base_url("https://api-dev.vegbank.org") vb_count_projects() vb_get_projects(search = "GAP", sort = "-obs_count") |>   dplyr::select(pj_code, project_name, obs_count) obs <- vb_get_plot_observations("pj.11044", sort = "author_obs_code",   limit = 100) obs |> dplyr::count(state_province) ob.135454 <- vb_get_plot_observations("ob.135454", detail = "full",   with_nested = TRUE) vb_get_taxon_observations("ob.135454") |>   dplyr::arrange(int_curr_plant_code) |>   print(n = 35) sequoia_communities <- vb_get_community_concepts(search = "sequoiadendron") sequoia_plots <- sequoia_communities |>   dplyr::arrange(-obs_count) |>   dplyr::slice(1) |>   dplyr::pull(cc_code) |>   vb_get_plot_observations()

title: Retrieve data from VegBank — vb_get
text: query considered "cross-resource collection query" vb_code provided prefix matching resource type differs target resource.  example, vb_get_plot_observations("pj.340"), return collection VegBank plot observation records corresponding project pj.340, project corresponding plot observations exist.

title: Retrieve data from VegBank — vb_get
text: query considered "full collection query" vb_code provided. example, vb_get_plot_observations() return plot observations. collection query types paginated via limit offset, can filtered parameters like search supported.

title: Retrieve data from VegBank — vb_get
text: Many parameters "smart defaults" change based whether querying single record collection records. general, single-record queries automatically use settings optimized detailed individual records (nested data, higher limits related entities), whereas collection queries use leaner settings.  example, vb_get_plot_observations() uses detail = "minimal" with_nested = FALSE collection queries, detail = "full" with_nested = TRUE single records. use API's defaults instead smart defaults, explicitly pass NULL parameter (e.g., detail = NULL).

title: Retrieve data from VegBank — vb_get
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Collection query - uses minimal detail and excludes nested fields plots <- vb_get_plot_observations(limit = 10)  # Single record - uses full detail with nested fields plot <- vb_get_plot_observations(vb_code = "ob.12345")  # Override defaults explicitly plots <- vb_get_plot_observations(limit = 10, detail = "full", num_taxa = 50)  # Use API defaults instead of smart defaults plots <- vb_get_plot_observations(limit = NULL, detail = NULL, num_taxa = NULL)  # Get projects (different available parameters) projects <- vb_get_projects(search = "heritage", limit = 20) } # }
